fullPassage: The shoreline was known for having the best fishing spots on the lake. Jessie was sitting at one of those spots, but her fishing line still hadn't moved an inch. With a deep sigh, Jessie pulled out the line and cast it back into the water. Her dream of catching a big fish was fading. "I can't believe I haven't caught a fish yet. Not a single one," she thought. Just as she was about to give up and leave, the fishing line suddenly became tense. Jessie excitedly held onto the fishing pole as it began to move around wildly. Her eyes widened and her heart began to beat faster with excitement. With a big smile, she could feel that this was the biggest fish she had ever caught!

With a deep sigh, Jessie pulled out the line and cast it back into the water. Her dream of catching a big fish was fading. "I can't believe I haven't caught a fish yet. Not a single one," she thought. Just as she was about to give up and leave, the fishing line suddenly became tense. Jessie excitedly held onto the fishing pole as it began to move around wildly. Her eyes widened and her heart began to beat faster with excitement. With a big smile, she could feel that this was the biggest fish she had ever caught!
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 원문: 큰 미소와 함께 가장 큰 물고기를 '잡았다'고 느낌 → 놓아주지 않음 → ④ 불일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① deep sigh + cast: 원문 일치
❌ ② Not a single one: 원문 일치
❌ ③ became tense: 원문 일치
✅ ④ 놓아주었다: 잡은 것이지 놓아준 게 아님 ← 정답(불일치)

ch: Jessie는 깊은 한숨을 쉬며 낚싯줄을 다시 던졌다.
Jessie는 한 마리의 물고기도 잡지 못했다고 생각했다.
Jessie는 큰 미소와 함께 물고기를 놓아주었다.
